metadata.title: Clicked like a maniac, enemy vanished like a ghost! Valorant aim makes no sense
metadata.description:
Me: spazzing out like I saw a bug
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-shock
How did that even hit? No clue but I'll take it
If your aim’s a lovable disaster, welcome to the club

Tap in if your aim surprises even you!
